FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.balance: one clean graph plus one accepted pseudo graph per eligible parent, exact 1:1; maximum 35,988 clean+35,988 pseudo train, 8,997 clean+8,997 pseudo validation
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.exclusion_reason: a GNSS-only corruption leaves all three primary nodes unchanged and would create an invisible graph target; eligibility follows modality policy, not downstream performance
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.future_adapter_contract: Read immutable N20 clean arrays and FIT whitelist; never call _scenario_rows or rebuild the N20 cache. Call unchanged _pseudo_for_scenario(raw, cached_parent_features, scenario_id, frozen_five_recipe_tuple, 0, 1, None) after enforcing FIT/TRAIN gates and window 12. Score corrupted features with loaded fitted_oneclass_parameters and fixed accepted calibrators, without any .fit call. Reuse cached clean p/E/A and exact untouched modality blocks. Export separate FIT-only arrays/provenance/skip ledger, never overwrite N20.
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.generator_call_seed: base_seed+t = t, exactly the existing _pseudo_for_scenario/_generate scheme; registry uses explicit PCG64 seed
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.no_effect: unchanged compact-modality np.allclose(rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-12) guard; remove both graph pair members if no effect, no resampling or fallback recipe; original cache is untouched
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.node_output_collisions: retain accepted compact-feature corruptions even if p/E/A coincides after a noninjective/saturated score mapping; log collisions, never filter using model outcomes
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.other_errors: missing inputs, nonfinite features or invalid required p/UQ fail closed; record issue without replacing a scenario or recipe
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.sampling_frequencies: fixed modulo rotation: Camera 2/5, Seg 1/5, IMU 2/5 up to endpoint counts and fixed no-effect skips; report realized counts
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.selection: recipe_order[t % 5]; same production rotation rule with eligibility subset fixed by primary modality validity
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.untouched_features: copy exact clean parent blocks; no repeated clean feature extraction
FIT_graph_pseudo_policy.window: temporal IMU corrupts [max(0,t-11),t] only; Camera/Seg corrupt instantaneous tick t; parent window metadata always records causal bounds

GAT_architecture.dropout_location: post-softmax normalized attention, exactly existing layer
GAT_architecture.final_activation: linear node logits; sigmoid only for node probability
GAT_architecture.initialization: Xavier uniform for every W and attention vector; identical cloned tensors per Standard/Epistemic seed
GAT_architecture.pooling: q_normal=mean_i sigmoid(z_i); no extra fusion, belief or decision layer

GNSS_primary_policy.basis: frozen scientific calibration-validity rule, not downstream graph performance

GNSS_inputs: mean of 5 raw GNSS normality scores
population std of those 5 raw scores (ddof=0)
GNSS_secondary.interpretation: GNSS is uncalibrated context only, unchanged within clean/pseudo pairs; this does not evaluate GNSS-only corruption detection and cannot replace the primary three-agent experiment
GNSS_secondary.label: exploratory raw-GNSS auxiliary-input ablation

NoGraph.architecture: bias-free shared Linear(3,12) -> ELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> bias-free Linear(12,1); mean(sigmoid(node_logit))
NoGraph.implementation: future report/adapter-side classifier; frozen core identity NoGraph remains unchanged
NoGraph.name: NoGraph shared-node MLP, distinct from frozen identity NoGraph plugin
NoGraph.reason: trainable nonlinear baseline with 48 parameters against 50 in each GAT; no deliberate information/capacity deficit

conformal_placement.candidate_nonconformity: 1-p_graph[true constructed class], subject to later scenario/exchangeability preregistration
conformal_placement.limitation: All 5 current CAL scenarios already fitted upstream probability mappings. Reusing them naively for split conformal does not establish independent calibration or a coverage guarantee. A separate future protocol must resolve calibration independence and temporal/scenario exchangeability; no new acquisition or upstream refitting is authorized here.
conformal_placement.stage: after graph methodology/model selection and output pipeline are frozen; before later separately authorized held-out evaluation

epistemic_attention.floating_point: reuse existing float32 prior/log implementation; tiny E can round to a neutral prior; accept weak/null effects without post-result amplification
epistemic_attention.monotonic: for fixed learned logits and other senders, increasing E_j decreases its normalized attention to each eligible receiver before dropout
epistemic_attention.neutral: use_epistemic_prior=False gives w=1; if every E=0 both attention operators coincide
epistemic_attention.scope: same original canonical E_j at both layers; sender prior only, no receiver factor
epistemic_attention.units: E is canonical entropy-gap in nats, not variance or its square root

information_matching: Both GATs and NoGraph receive the identical p/E/A vector. EpistemicGAT reuses the same E through a fixed attention prior; this tests the prior contribution beyond E as an ordinary predictive covariate.
interpretation_limits: constructed pseudo distribution and artificial 1:1 prevalence
